upstreams.name: colibri
upstreams.use: The int4-rans256-g0 codec as published: c/rans.h (header-only C99 rANS, its scalar and branch-free decode arms) through its own ctypes bridge c/tools/rans_ctypes.c, compiled by the codec crate's build script; c/tools/rans_format.py's frequency quantizer and table builder, run unmodified to make Colibri's tables; c/tools/analyze_split_entropy.py read as the method of its 2.91-bit measurement. Nothing else of Colibri is built.
